CustomField.description: Concatenation of all the Territory checkboxes displayed in a single field for use on list views and reports.
CustomField.formula: SUBSTITUTE( IF(TERR_BHSP__c, "BHSP,",NULL) + IF(TERR_NE__c , "NE,",NULL) + IF(TERR_NSCENTRAL__c , "NSCENTRAL,",NULL) + IF(TERR_OHAPH__c, "OHAPH,",NULL) + IF(TERR_OHCIN__c, "OHCIN,",NULL) + IF(TERR_OHCIS__c, "OHCIS,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHHVIN__c, "OHHVIN,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHHVIS__c, "OHHVIS,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHICLM__c, "OHICLM,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHICOC__c, "OHICOC,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHICSL__c, "OHICSL,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHICSO__c, "OHICSO,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHICWP__c, "OHICWP,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHJOI__c, "OHJOI,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHNRI__c, "OHNRI,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_OHWPH__c, "OHWPH,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_ORMC__c, "ORMC,",NULL)+ IF(TERR_SE__c, "SE,",NULL)+".", ",.",NULL)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays a list of all the territories assigned to this zip code.
CustomField.label: Territories
